description: Ω8 discovery engine — mapping. CONSTRAINT SOLVING of inferred SurfaceContracts (discovery.infer@1 output) against a domain pack blueprint (the pack's CONTRACT contributions: passed as payload — e.g. the parsed packs/domain-email/plugin.json — or read from a fixed path in config). Each blueprint op must bind to exactly one candidate (op-name match, non-empty selector, risk-class compatibility: blueprint EXTERNAL_MUTATION needs candidate riskHint EXTERNAL_MUTATION); unbindable blueprint op → UNSAT with a gap report; extra candidates → recorded as surplus, never an error. D-308 adds discovery.variations@1: the same candidates grouped by canonical contract id as co-promotable Variations (one op, many live realizations). Reports persist to the user's vault.

engine.doc: map {candidates, blueprint?, blueprintPath?, runId?, candidatesRef?} → {satisfied, bindings[], gaps[], surplus[], vaultRef} — blueprint = a pack manifest object (contributions.contract[] is extracted) or a normalized {ops:[{op, risk}]} doc; falls back to ctx.config.blueprintPath when the payload omits it. Semantic risk class: READ (mapping solves a constraint problem; risk fields are legal on contract-kind contributions only per the pinned manifest grammar).

variations {candidates, providerId, runId?, discoveredAt?} → {variations[], byContract, vaultRef} — group candidates by canonical contract id into Variation rows (channel/status/evidence per realization; several Variations per contractId may sit at PROMOTED simultaneously). Persisted to ns discovery as variations:<runId>.

capabilities.justification: The mapping report (bindings + gaps + surplus) is persisted to the USER'S VAULT (ns 'discovery', id 'mapping:<runId>', refs = candidatesRef + the bound candidates' evidence — provenance edges). Granted per-composition by the user-signed Recipe, never by this manifest.
